title: Left Side Weapons Bay
label: SOURCED
summary: Lateral internal weapons bay located along the left intake shoulder housing one short-range AIM-9 Sidewinder.
role: Carries one infrared-guided AIM-9 missile internally with a trapeze launcher that extends the seeker into the airstream before launch.
